system.description:
You manipulate light and darkness to create an illusionary image.

Choose a point within 10 spaces. For 1 minute, an illusion of your choosing appears in the space.

The illusion is purely visual and cannot make any sound. The illusion can be a creature, object, or some other environmental effect. It may occupy up to a 5-space-radius or be as small as you wish.

The illusion may be static or move in a predetermined manner, such as a wheel turning or a cat breathing.

You may use an Action to direct the illusion in response to the environment.

You may have only one illusion active at a time, but you could have multiple objects in the same space as part of the same illusion, such as a table set with dinner plates.

If the illusion is innocuous, most creatures will assume it is real. If a creature inspects the illusion, they may make an opposed Willpower check to recognize it as fake.

Any physical interaction with the illusion reveals its true nature, as creatures and objects can pass through it.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 minutes.
